about.intro: I am an AI Engineering student focused on learning and building across the main AI tracks, with special interest in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and NLP.
about.body: My goal is to grow as a well-rounded AI Engineer by building practical projects that connect intelligent models with useful real-world applications. I keep expanding my skills through hands-on work, continuous learning, and a strong interest in the full AI landscape.
principles: Build strong programming and math fundamentals before chasing advanced models
Turn learning into small working projects that can be tested and explained
Document the problem, tools, decisions, and lessons behind each project
Connect AI logic with usable interfaces so projects are easier to understand

projects.title: Base Calc
projects.summary: A desktop application built with WPF and C# for handling base calculations and number-system conversion in a clean, simple, and educational interface.

details.challenge: Build a useful desktop tool that makes base conversion and calculation easier to understand and use for students and learners.
details.solution: I created a WPF-based desktop experience with clear inputs, accurate calculation logic, and a straightforward interface focused on speed and simplicity.
impact: Made base conversion easier to test and validate
Delivered a practical educational utility in C#

projects.title: Mini Physics Lab Simulator
projects.summary: A small virtual physics lab built with WPF and C# to simulate electrical circuit experiments using bulbs, resistors, a voltmeter, an ammeter, batteries, and switches.

details.challenge: Recreate a simple but realistic physics lab experience in software so users can interact with circuit elements in a clear and understandable way.
details.solution: I designed an interactive desktop simulator where users can connect and explore electrical elements visually while observing values through virtual measuring tools.
impact: Turned physical circuit ideas into an interactive software experience
Improved my understanding of simulation-oriented problem solving
Created a useful educational project with real component interaction

projects.title: AI-Powered Pharmacy Platform
projects.summary: A full pharmacy website supported by AI, designed to provide a modern digital experience for showcasing products, improving user interaction, and expanding into smarter pharmacy workflows.

details.challenge: Build a complete pharmacy website that goes beyond a standard storefront by adding AI support to improve the overall digital experience.
details.solution: I developed a full web platform structure that combines product presentation, service-oriented flows, and AI support to make the project feel smarter and more modern.
impact: Showcased my ability to combine web development with AI concepts
Created a stronger full-stack style portfolio project
Built a foundation that can grow into a smarter pharmacy product
